summary: Iteration 47 — Role-Based Approval Gate + Execution Plan Options + Workflows-in-MyWork + Voice Cancel. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS (test_iteration47_approval.py): cookie-based login sets dos_token httponly cookie, /api/users PATCH permissions accepts 'approvals' key, task with approval_required→status=blocked/approval_status=pending, PATCH status/progress blocked with 403 while pending, plan generate/save blocked with 403 while pending, role-based approver (finance with 'approvals' perm can approve when no approver_id; sales without perm cannot; specific approver_id restricts approval to that user + owner), approve→status blocked→todo/approval_status=approved, status/progress/done work after approve (no 2nd approval), reject keeps blocked with rejection_reason. Execution plan generate→draft, save→accepted, DELETE clears plan. Non-approval task path normal. No _id leak. Frontend Playwright: /workflows redirects to /my-work?view=workflows; sidebar has no nav-workflows; MyWork view toggle exposes work-view-workflows tab rendering kanban board; NewTaskDialog has task-approval-required + task-approver-select (filtered to owner + users with 'approvals' perm — 'Sunita Rao · finance' appeared after granting perm); created task shows Pending approval chip + approval-actions block with approve/reject buttons; approve→approval-actions removed, status-select + generate-plan + manual-plan buttons appear, chip flips to Approved; Board view has PENDING APPROVAL column; Access Control modal renders perm-approvals ('Approve Tasks') via Team.js code+ dropdown filter evidence; voice-cancel-button (Decision Desk) + voice-cancel-<taskId> (task card) both gated correctly behind `recording` state.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 4423 lines — the same file-size concern flagged in iterations 44/45/46 continues. Task approval + execution-plan (~200 lines from 1900-2140) is a clean extraction candidate to routers/tasks.py.

test_credentials.md still documents 'Auth: JWT Bearer token' as the primary auth mechanism, but the app is now cookie-first (httponly dos_token via set_auth_cookie). Bearer is a fallback via get_current_user. Update the file to reflect cookie-first auth so future testers don't hardcode Authorization headers.

Consistency: _can_approve_task allows owner OR approver_id OR (no approver_id AND 'approvals' perm). However, delete_execution_plan uses _can_work_task (assignee OR owner OR same-role) but is NOT blocked by 'approval_required && status!=approved'. That means an assignee could DELETE a plan (or one may not even exist) on a not-yet-approved task. Low-severity since the plan didn't exist yet in that state anyway, but consider mirroring the generate/save guard on delete for consistency.

MyWork.js file is 761 lines (multiple concerns: task card, execution plan sub-component, view toggle, voice recording). Consider extracting <TaskCard>, <ExecutionPlan>, <VoiceRecorder> into their own files.

Board view shows 'PENDING APPROVAL' as a first-class column (not just a status filter). That's great UX but note: PENDING APPROVAL is derived from status='blocked' + approval_status='pending' — if a blocked task exists without approval_required=true it may appear here incorrectly. Verify the derivation logic guards against this in Tasks.js columns definition.

Approver dropdown text 'Grant approval access to a user in People → Access Control' (Tasks.js:169) is helpful, but if no non-owner has the 'approvals' perm the dropdown shows only owner. Consider a warning banner when the current tenant has zero users with 'approvals' perm.

Notification storm — every approval-required task creates a level-2 notification to all owners. Over the course of testing this iteration alone, the Messages panel accumulated 10+ 'Approval needed…' rows. Consider dedup/collapse for the same approver over a short window.
reject stores 'rejection_reason' as a distinct field (good — fixes the iter-46 concern about clarify/reject overloading clarification_note). Kudos.

(Optional/UX) Warn in NewTaskDialog when the tenant has no non-owner user with 'approvals' perm so the approver dropdown isn't just 'owner + anyone'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 47 (Role-Based Approval + Execution Plan Options + Workflows-in-MyWork + Voice Cancel) is fully working. (2) approval-required task flow: status starts 'blocked', approval_status 'pending'; PATCH status/progress → 403; plan generate/save → 403; only _can_approve_task users (owner OR approver_id OR no-approver_id+approvals-perm) can approve; approve unlocks (blocked→todo, approval_status=approved); no 2nd approval needed. (7) test_credentials.md still says 'JWT Bearer' — update it to note cookie-first auth for next agent.
